content.text: In Bangladesh, digital creators face a stark reality: Stripe and PayPal are not options. Your ability to sell online depends on infrastructure you control—not platforms that can suspend you without notice. This is not about workarounds; it’s about owning your commerce stack from the ground up. COREMERCH provides the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-9|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|Payment Options]]-5|architecture]] to achieve this. No subscriptions. No gatekeeping. Full ownership of your storefront, customer data, and payment flow. Built in Zimbabwe, this system is pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. It works where others fail.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy rent you a temporary storefront. They control your customer list, order history, and product files. If they suspend you, your business vanishes overnight. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) gives you permanent ownership of your infrastructure. You deploy GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The stack is yours to modify, scale, and relocate. No platform lock-in. No recurring fees. You own the code, the data, and the wallet addresses. This is not a SaaS product—it’s a sovereign commerce stack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal enforce geographic gatekeeping through KYC requirements and banking partnerships. If your country is restricted, you’re excluded by design. COREMERCH eliminates this barrier by leveraging no-KYC crypto payments. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, and buyers do not need an account to pay. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The system is deployed on globally accessible infrastructure: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, and Supabase. No single entity can suspend your store. This architecture is built for creators in regions where traditional payment processors refuse to operate.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal hold your funds for days or weeks, deducting 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Crypto payments through NOWPayments confirm in minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee. There are no chargebacks, no rolling reserves, and no hidden costs. The Complete Builder Kit is a one-time $197 investment. After deployment, your only expense is the payment processing fee. Compare this to subscription-based platforms that charge monthly fees plus transaction cuts. With COREMERCH, you own the infrastructure outright. No recurring costs. No revenue sharing. Your profit margins are yours to keep.
Own your commerce stack—no platform lock-in, no geographic gatekeeping.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On platforms like Gumroad, your customer data and product files are stored on servers you do not control. COREMERCH’s stacks use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring you retain full ownership of your digital assets. Orders are automatically logged in your own Supabase or Google Sheets database. Payment verification is handled via NOWPayments webhooks, triggering instant product delivery. The system runs without your intervention. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You control everything—from the storefront code to the wallet addresses receiving payments. This is infrastructure sovereignty in practice.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling digital products in Bangladesh and cannot rely on Stripe or PayPal, COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit is the only architecture designed for your context. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Deploy it if you need full ownership of your commerce stack, instant global payments, and zero platform dependency. Choose this if you’re tired of geographic gatekeeping and want to build on infrastructure you control. The $197 investment is a fraction of what you’d pay in recurring fees to platforms that can suspend you at any time. This is not a gamble; it’s a strategic decision to own your financial future.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit provides digital creators in Bangladesh with a sovereign commerce stack that bypasses geographic restrictions. For $197, you get blueprints and templates to deploy a storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. The system is designed for full ownership, automatic delivery, and no recurring fees. It’s the only architecture built to withstand payment rejection and financial isolation.
Crypto payments confirm in minutes with a flat 0.5% fee.

Creators researching infrastructure ownership and no-KYC payment options are typically at a turning point — ready to build on infrastructure they control after experiencing or observing the asymmetric risk of platform dependency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete sovereign deployment: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all under your accounts, end-to-end tested before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build process for both Stack 01 and Stack 02 for creators who want to self-deploy. COREMERCH has no access after delivery. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end functionality. 8. Deploy your live storefront. 9. Load your first 5 products. 10. Retain full ownership of your stack.
